description: Weekly Swiftember member shout-outs and special event highlights

week_1.name: Jack Dean
week_1.message: Training hard and putting in big miles in preparation for the Chicago Marathon!

week_1.name: Alice Wilkinson & Jake Colbourn
week_1.message: Massive good luck to Alice & Jake who are taking on their epic 50-mile Ultra Marathon on September 12th!

week_1.name: Neesa
week_1.message: Putting in the hard yards with strength and conditioning sessions at the gym to boost power and support her running!

week_1.name: Chris W
week_1.message: Keeping the running streak blazing strong while adding extra mileage and longer runs to the calendar!

week_2.name: Adrián Nieves
week_2.message: Currently in an injury recovery phase, Adrián is steadily rebuilding fitness with a focus on completing an 8 km run in Seville at the end of September. The club extends its best wishes for his continued recovery and upcoming event.

week_2.name: Barry Cassidy
week_2.message: Barry is managing his return from injury with structured training in preparation for the Great Scottish Run on October 4th. His disciplined approach to rehabilitation and mileage provides a solid foundation for the half marathon in Glasgow.

week_2.name: Jon Williams
week_2.message: Jon has demonstrated solid progress while recovering from injury, logging 20.0 km in Week 2 to reach 25.0 km total (71.4% of his 35 km monthly target). His consistent and measured approach also earned him the Week 2 Rising Swift award.

week_2.name: Ian Bush
week_2.message: Ian continues his steady recovery from an ankle injury, pacing his return carefully. He has logged 30.9 km to date, completing 61.8% of his 50 km monthly pledge.

week_2.name: Simon Stockdale
week_2.message: Simon is building mileage toward the Yorkshire Marathon on October 18th while working toward his 80 km Swiftember pledge. With 57.8 km completed across the first two weeks, his endurance training remains well underway.

week_2.name: Jack Whitfield
week_2.message: Jack joined the challenge this week and has already reached his monthly pledge, completing 26.3 km against his 25 km target (105.2%). A commendable effort in his opening fortnight.

week_2.name: Alice Wilkinson
week_2.message: Congratulations to Alice on completing her 50-mile Ultra Marathon on September 12th. She logged an impressive 83.0 km during Week 2, achieving 265.6% of her weekly quota and earning Road Warrior honors.

week_2.name: Jake Colbourn
week_2.message: Congratulations to Jake on finishing his 50-mile Ultra Marathon on September 12th. His week included an 81.9 km long run, 109.0 km total distance, and 1,731 m of elevation gain, earning Mountain Goat honors.

week_3.title: 🇩🇪 SPECIAL EVENT SPOTLIGHT • BMW BERLIN MARATHON 2026
week_3.headline: ALL THE BEST TO OUR 13 BERLIN MARATHON SWIFTS! 🏃‍♂️💨🇩🇪
week_3.intro: A huge club shoutout and best wishes to all 13 Birmingham Swifts heading to Germany this weekend to conquer the iconic 42.195 km Berlin course! From marathon debutants to World Marathon Major star chasers and Boston qualifiers, the entire club is cheering you across the finish line through the Brandenburg Gate!
week_3.footer: 🇩🇪 Gute Reise & smash those 42.195 km through the streets of Berlin! The whole club will be live tracking and cheering you on! 🏅

runners.name: Mark Blakeman
runners.message: Chasing his 3rd World Marathon Major star and working hard to secure a Good for Age qualifying time for the Boston Marathon.

runners.name: Alexander Brown
runners.message: Overcame tough difficulties during marathon training and picked himself right back up for the final push into Berlin.

runners.name: Bo Wang
runners.message: After Paris and London Marathon earlier this year, another dedicated marathoner on the hunt for his 3rd World Marathon Major star through the streets of Berlin.

runners.name: Chris Bainbridge
runners.message: Battled through a painful injury during training, bounced back impressively, and logged the most distance in Swiftember among all Berlin runners.

runners.name: Helen Williams
runners.message: Taking on her second full marathon of the year following the Paris Marathon earlier this spring. What a phenomenal achievement!

runners.name: Ian Allen
runners.message: A true half and full marathon junkie who trains relentlessly and has lined up for the most races among all our Berlin runners.

runners.name: Joe Pinder
runners.message: Calm, composed, and steady, quietly banking huge miles and putting tremendous effort into his Berlin Marathon build.

runners.name: Richard Lakin
runners.message: Temporarily traded his love for beer for marathon miles! Berlin is his second World Marathon Major after New York last autumn.

runners.name: Michael Lakin
runners.message: Berlin is also his second full marathon after New York last year, proving time and again that he never gives up when the going gets tough.

runners.name: Josh Savage
runners.message: Our club chair who likes to moan and complain a lot in the group chat, but backed it up with massive dedication and effort in his marathon training!

runners.name: Matthew Rushton
runners.message: A newcomer to the Berlin Marathon who caught up nicely during training and built wonderful momentum heading into race weekend.

runners.name: Tim Reeves
runners.message: Tackling his very first full marathon! Put so much hard work into this marathon training block and will definitely smash Berlin.

runners.name: Richard Wilkes
runners.message: Proud pastry and meat lover, and grueling marathon training miles haven't changed that dietary fuel strategy one single bit!

additional_shoutouts.name: London Pride 10K Swifts Team
additional_shoutouts.message: A massive club shoutout and huge congratulations to all 24 Swifts who showed up in force and took on the London Pride 10K over the weekend with fantastic club spirit and brilliant running!

additional_shoutouts.name: Benjamin Lane
additional_shoutouts.message: Came first among the Swifts team at the London Pride 10K, and clocked a blistering week to secure the Week 3 Speed Demon title!

additional_shoutouts.name: Lee Singleton
additional_shoutouts.message: The London Pride 10K is the most he has pushed himself since recovering from his injury following a seizure last year, marking an inspiring milestone!

additional_shoutouts.name: Pete Hall
additional_shoutouts.message: The London Pride 10K was his first ever official race, and he smashed it! He has also committed to a huge mileage target this Swiftember.

final_finishers.name: Thomas Glave
final_finishers.tag: 👑 Distance King • Highest Total Mileage (282.1 km)
final_finishers.analysis: 282.1 km across 24 runs, 250 km target, 1,343 m elevation, Berlin Marathon 42.6 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged the highest total mileage of the challenge with 282.1 km across 24 runs, exceeding his 250 km target by 32.1 km. His month included 1,343 m of elevation gain and the Berlin Marathon (42.6 km).

final_finishers.name: Adrián Nieves
final_finishers.analysis: 51.7 km on 25 km target, 9 runs, 217 m elevation, returned to running 1.5 months ago.
final_finishers.shoutout: Returned to running a month and a half ago, using Swiftember as the perfect motivation to keep pushing and stay consistent. Originally planning for a 25 km target, he ended up logging 51.7 km across 9 runs (206.8% completion) with 217 m of climbing.

final_finishers.name: Mark Blakeman
final_finishers.analysis: 215.0 km on 150 km target, +65.0 km surplus, 1,166 m elev, 4x 50k+ weeks, Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Generated the largest surplus distance in the club (+65.0 km), logging 215.0 km across 18 runs with 1,166 m of climbing. Averaged over 50 km weekly and completed the Berlin Marathon (42.7 km) to secure his 3rd World Major star.

final_finishers.name: Anthony Morgan
final_finishers.analysis: 135.8 km on 75 km target, 15 runs, 992 m elevation, consecutive 40k+ weeks.
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged 135.8 km on a 75 km target (+60.8 km surplus) across 15 runs with 992 m of climbing. Established a strong early foundation with consecutive 40 km+ weeks in the first fortnight, including a 21.4 km half marathon.

final_finishers.name: Joe Pinder
final_finishers.analysis: 208.2 km on 150 km target, 17 runs, 1,324 m elevation, 3x 50k+ weeks, Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Finished with 208.2 km against a 150 km pledge (+58.2 km surplus) across 17 runs with 1,324 m of elevation. Maintained three separate 50 km+ training weeks before completing the Berlin Marathon (42.6 km).

final_finishers.name: Jon Williams
final_finishers.analysis: 68.2 km on 35 km target, 10 runs, 247 m elev, progressive build from 5 km to 20 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Achieved 194.9% of his monthly target, logging 68.2 km against a 35 km pledge across 10 outings. Rebuilt mileage progressively from 5.0 km in Week 1 to 20.0 km in Week 2, sustaining 16 to 22 km weekly thereafter.

final_finishers.name: Andrea Bohn
final_finishers.tag: 👟 Frequency Leader (35 km Cohort) • 21 Runs Logged
final_finishers.analysis: 21 runs logged, 63.1 km on 35 km target (180.3%), consistent every-other-day outings.
final_finishers.shoutout: Recorded 21 runs across the 5 weeks—the highest run frequency among participants with a 35 km target. Logged 63.1 km total, exceeding her pledge by 28.1 km (180.3% completion).

final_finishers.name: Richard Lakin
final_finishers.analysis: 152.1 km on 100 km target, 8 runs, 660 m elev, Berlin Marathon 42.6 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged 152.1 km on a 100 km pledge across 8 outings with 660 m of climbing (+52.1 km surplus). Completed three 30–40 km preparatory weeks, concluding with the Berlin Marathon (42.6 km) in Week 4.

final_finishers.name: Bradley M 🏳️‍🌈💪🏃‍♂️
final_finishers.analysis: 26.1 km on 20 km target, 5 runs, back-to-back 10 km weeks in Weeks 3 & 4 (10.1 km Week 4).
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged 26.1 km against a 20 km pledge across 5 runs with 126 m of elevation gain. Reached goal via back-to-back ~10 km weeks in the second half of September, including a 10.1 km run in Week 4.

final_finishers.name: Laura Rafailov
final_finishers.analysis: 101.8 km on 100 km target, 14 runs, 666 m elevation, dedicated preparation to break 60 mins.
final_finishers.shoutout: Targeted a sub-60 minute 10K milestone during Swiftember, utilizing the challenge to structure dedicated preparation. Achieved the objective at the London Pride 10K with an official finish of 58:57, concluding the month with 101.8 km logged on a 100 km pledge across 14 outings.

final_finishers.name: Chris W
final_finishers.analysis: 53.6 km on 50 km target, 6 runs, 343 m elev, Leafy 10K PB in Bournville (beating last year debut).
final_finishers.shoutout: Returned to Bournville for the Leafy 10K, the site of his very first race last year. Aiming for a personal best and to beat his previous year's time, he accomplished both, concluding Swiftember with 53.6 km logged on a 50 km pledge (107.2% of goal).

final_finishers.name: Jack Dean
final_finishers.analysis: 244.0 km on 200 km target, 22 runs, 1,908 m elevation, 32.0 km long run.
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged 244.0 km across 22 runs with 1,908 m of elevation gain as part of Chicago Marathon preparation. Maintained high weekly mileage throughout September, with a peak long run of 32.0 km.

final_finishers.name: Christopher Bainbridge
final_finishers.analysis: 264.7 km on 250 km target, 25 runs, 1,231 m elev, consistent 60-75 km weeks, Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Recorded the second-highest mileage in the club with 264.7 km across 25 runs and 1,231 m of elevation. Maintained consistent weekly mileage between 60 and 75 km, including completion of the Berlin Marathon.

final_finishers.name: Alice Wilkinson
final_finishers.tag: 🏔 Endurance Titan • Longest Single Run (83.0 km)
final_finishers.analysis: 132.6 km on 125 km target, 10 runs, 727 m elev, 83.0 km 50-mile Ultra on Sep 12.
final_finishers.shoutout: Completed the longest single activity of Swiftember with an 83.0 km 50-mile ultra-marathon on September 12. Concluded the month with 132.6 km across 10 outings with 727 m of climbing (106.1% of target).

final_finishers.name: Jake Colbourn
final_finishers.tag: 👟 Run Machine • Most Runs (27) & Elevation Record
final_finishers.analysis: 27 runs (club high), 204.4 km, 3,074 m elevation (club record), 81.9 km 50-mile Ultra.
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged the highest number of runs in the club with 27 outings, totaling 204.4 km. Set club-leading marks in elevation gain (3,074 m) and completed an 81.9 km 50-mile ultra-marathon on September 12.

final_finishers.name: Adam Bown
final_finishers.analysis: 208.1 km on 200 km target, 21 runs, 1,727 m elev, 4:45 /km average pace, 21.2 km max.
final_finishers.shoutout: Registered the fastest average pace among high-volume runners, averaging 4:45 /km across 208.1 km and 21 runs. Also accumulated 1,727 m of climbing with a longest single run of 21.2 km.

final_finishers.name: Benjamin Lane
final_finishers.analysis: 106.5 km on 100 km target, 11 runs, 680 m elevation, 4:58 /km pace, Week 3 Speed Demon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged 106.5 km on a 100 km target across 11 outings with 680 m of climbing, maintaining an overall average pace of 4:58 /km. In Week 3, became the sole runner to dethrone Adam Bown for the weekly Speed Demon award, averaging 4:48 /km across 18.0 km.

final_finishers.name: Alexander Brown
final_finishers.analysis: 233.2 km on 200 km target, 19 runs, 1,354 m elev, 63.6 km Week 4 peak, Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Completed 233.2 km across 19 runs with 1,354 m of climbing. Reached a peak volume of 63.6 km in Week 4 and completed the Berlin Marathon (42.6 km).

final_finishers.name: Bo Wang
final_finishers.analysis: 228.3 km on 200 km target, 20 runs, 5:11 /km pace, 694 m elev, Berlin Marathon 42.6 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Completed 228.3 km across 20 runs at an average pace of 5:11 /km with 694 m of elevation. Opened with an 86.1 km volume in Week 1 and completed the Berlin Marathon (42.6 km) to secure a third World Marathon Major star.

final_finishers.name: Ian Allen 🏳️‍🌈
final_finishers.analysis: 217.6 km on 200 km target, 21 runs, 1,754 m elev (2nd highest), Berlin Marathon 42.5 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Recorded 217.6 km across 21 runs with 1,754 m of elevation gain, representing the second-highest climbing total in the club. Completed the Berlin Marathon (42.5 km) in Week 4.

final_finishers.name: Joshua Savage
final_finishers.analysis: 201.4 km on 200 km target, 18 runs, 2,759 m elev (3rd highest), Berlin Marathon 42.6 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Accumulated 201.4 km across 18 runs and 2,759 m of elevation gain (third-highest climbing total in the club), alongside completing the Berlin Marathon (42.6 km).

final_finishers.name: Helen Williams
final_finishers.analysis: 141.5 km on 125 km target, 11 runs, 874 m elev, completed Berlin Marathon after Paris.
final_finishers.shoutout: Logged 141.5 km across 11 runs with 874 m of elevation, completing the Berlin Marathon (42.4 km). This marked her second World Marathon Major distance finish of 2026, following Paris earlier in the year.

final_finishers.name: Lee Singleton
final_finishers.analysis: 102.0 km on 100 km target, 13 runs, 863 m elev, first 100k block since seizure recovery.
final_finishers.shoutout: Completed 102.0 km across 13 runs with 863 m of elevation gain, achieving 102.0% of his 100 km pledge. This represents his first full 100 km month following medical recovery from a seizure last year.
